title: Android Components and Service Boundaries Quick Check

questions.prompt: Match each component to its primary contract.
questions.explanation: Android activates each component under a different system contract.

questions.prompt: A Service automatically executes callbacks on a worker thread.
questions.explanation: A service normally runs on the application main thread and must arrange non-blocking work.

questions.prompt: Which API best fits deferrable retryable note backup?
questions.explanation: The job needs constraints, persistence, and retry without continuous user visibility.
